$comment: Civic Access Score. BUILD_PROMPT.md Section 8.1. Weights are user-adjustable in the interface and the formula is printed on the Rankings screen. A black-box index reads as hand-waving.

health.$comment: Population-weighted mean travel minutes to nearest hospital or basic health unit. Linear interpolation between points.

education.$comment: Same bands, nearest primary or secondary school.

air.$comment: 24-hour mean PM2.5. ADR-9 canonical scale. Same breakpoints as the severity ramp: 12, 35, 55, 150, 250.

green.$comment: Square metres of mapped park or green area per resident. WHO minimum recommendation is 9.

connectivity.$comment: Road length per square kilometre, normalised against the district maximum, plus an intersection density term.

rules.$comment: A missing component is EXCLUDED and the remaining weights renormalise to sum to 1.0. Never substitute zero. A missing park layer is not zero parks.
